# resume-tailor

> Deterministic, schema-driven resume generator CLI and AI Skill for Claude Code & GitHub Copilot.
> Keeps one verified JSON source of truth and tailors it honestly to every job description — never fabricating a skill, metric, or job title you don't have.

## Overview
- Website: https://subho57.github.io/resume-tailor/
- Repository: https://github.com/subho57/resume-tailor
- License: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)
- Privacy: 100% Local / In-Browser Execution. Zero telemetry, zero external server calls.

## Key Features
- **Zero Fabrication Guarantee**: Selects and rephrases real achievements matching target job keywords; explicitly forbids inventing facts.
- **1-Page Autofit Engine**: Algorithmic layout fitting so resumes stay strictly 1 page without overflow.
- **Deterministic Output**: JSON content + Theme preset -> Native DOCX & PDF output with corporate styling.
- **AI Coding Agent Skills**: Bundled standalone skills (`jd-tailored-resume` and `master-resume-builder`) for Claude Code (`~/.claude/skills/`) and GitHub Copilot (`~/.copilot/skills/`).

## Quick Install (macOS / Linux)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://subho57.github.io/resume-tailor/install.sh | bash
```

## CLI Usage & Flags
```bash
# Basic DOCX + PDF generation
tailor-resume --content resume.json --theme corporate-navy --one-pager

# Output directory and custom options
tailor-resume --content resume.json --theme slate-compact --out build/

# Install standalone AI Skills for Claude Code & Copilot
tailor-resume --install-skill
```

## Bundled AI Skills
1. **`master-resume-builder`**: Compiles raw work history notes or LinkedIn exports into a structured, validated ground-truth `resume.json`.
2. **`jd-tailored-resume`**: Honestly tailors `resume.json` against a target job description file without hallucinatory facts.
